title: Reverberator
text: Add reverberation to audio signal, 7 inputs, 1 output, no direct feedthrough; {Pre-delay (s)} sets the pre-delay for reverberation, {Highcut frequency (Hz)} sets the lowpass filter cutoff, {Diffusion} sets the density of reverb tail, {Decay factor}, {High frequency damping} sets the high-frequency damping, {Wet/dry mix} sets the ratio of wet, {Inherit sample rate from input} sets the source of input sample rate, {Input sample rate (Hz)} sets the sample rate of input and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Delay
ports.summary: Pre-delay for reverberation (s) scalar in the range [0,1]

ports.name: HighCut
ports.summary: Lowpass filter cutoff positive scalar in the range [0, (Sample Rate)/2]

ports.name: Diffusion
ports.summary: Density of reverb tail scalar in the range [0,1]

ports.name: Decay
ports.summary: Decay factor of reverb tail scalar in the range [0,1]

ports.name: Damping
ports.summary: High-frequency damping scalar in the range [0,1]

ports.name: WetDry
ports.summary: Ratio of wet (reverberated) signal to dry (original) signal scalar in the range [0,1]

params.name: Pre-delay (s)
params.values: Pre-delay for reverberation 0 (default) | scalar in the range [0, 1]

params.name: Highcut frequency (Hz)
params.values: Lowpass filter cutoff 20000 (default) | scalar in the range [0, (Sample Rate)/2]

params.name: Diffusion
params.values: Density of reverb tail 0.50 (default) | scalar in the range [0, 1]

params.name: Decay factor
params.values: Decay factor of reverb tail 0.50 (default) | scalar in the range [0, 1]

params.name: High frequency damping
params.values: High-frequency damping 0.0005 (default) | scalar in the range [0, 1]

params.name: Wet/dry mix
params.values: Ratio of wet (reverberated) signal to dry (original) signal 0.3 (default) | scalar in the range [0, 1]

params.name: Inherit sample rate from input
params.values: Specify source of input sample rate on (default) | off

params.name: Input sample rate (Hz)
params.values: Sample rate of input 44100 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Specify type of simulation to run Interpreted execution (default) | Code generation
